notes.title: Gamescom 2024
notes.content:
[b]Find us at Gamescom![/b]

GraveyardGambit will be showcased at a booth on two days during Gamescom. Here, you can test the game and chat with the developers [b]Emelie Dahlmeyer[/b] and [b]Malte Lehmann[/b].

[b]Where can you find us?[/b]

Hall 10.2 - E20/D22 at the [b]GameUp! Rheinland-Pfalz[/b] joint booth.

[b]When can you find us?[/b]

[list]
[*] Wednesday, 21st August, from 12 PM to 2 PM
[*] Saturday, 24th August, from 5 PM to 7 PM
[/list]

We look forward to seeing you!

notes.title: New Achievements
notes.content:
[b]New Update:[/b]

There are 3 new achievements:

[list]
[*] [b]1. Reach Raid 100[/b]
[*] [b]2. Collect 3 experience points in a single raid[/b]
[*] [b]3. Watch a fireworks display from a bench[/b]
[/list]

[b]Additional Changes:[/b]

To make the game more challenging in later rounds, 2 new guards have been added in rounds 60 and 80.  
The maximum number of players listed on the leaderboard has been increased to 50.

[b]Hotfixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where a wall would become invisible.
[*] Fixed an issue where some names on the leaderboard were unreadable.
[/list]

notes.title: Leaderboard Steam Global and Friends
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45103258/5fbe5d881bfca46c27a5c66a90eec4c2bfd2f073.png[/img]

[b]Starting today, you can compete with your friends in GraveyardGambit. The best of the best will even be shown in the Top 25 on the Global Leaderboard.[/b]

[b]Specific Updates:[/b]

[list]
[*] Each time you increase your high score, it is automatically entered into the leaderboard.
[*] In the "Leaderboard" tab, you can see the Top 25 players globally.
[*] In the "Leaderboard" tab, you can see the Top 25 players on your friends list.
[*] You can switch between the global and friends leaderboard by selecting the "Friends" or "Global" buttons.
[*] If you delete all data via "Restart" - "Delete All", your leaderboard entry will also be reset.
[/list]

[b]Note:[/b] Your leaderboard entry can only be updated a maximum of 10 times within 10 minutes. This is due to Steam's leaderboard system guidelines, not the game.

notes.title: Experience Points and permanent Upgrades
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45103258/e47c2d6bc2c1e5e70e371539fac3da62f6041301.png[/img]

In this update, a second currency has arrived in [b]GraveyardGambit[/b]. You can use experience points to purchase permanent upgrades that persist even between individual rounds.

[b]Earning Experience Points:[/b]

For each raid you successfully complete, you earn an experience point. Your experience points collected from raids are credited to you at the end of a round.

[b]Upgrades:[/b]

There are 2 types of permanent upgrades: [b]Levelable Upgrades[/b] and [b]Mega Upgrades[/b].

[b]Levelable Upgrades:[/b]

You can upgrade levelable upgrades up to 7 times. These upgrades help you in every round.

[list]
[*] [b]Speed Upgrade[/b] (Increases your running speed)
[*] [b]Alarm Timer Upgrade[/b] (Increases the time of the alarm timer)
[*] [b]Guard Speed Reduction[/b] (Reduces the running speed of guards)
[*] [b]Bonus Gold[/b] (Gain bonus gold for successfully opening a grave)
[*] [b]Stamina Regeneration[/b] (Your stamina bar refills faster)
[/list]

[b]Mega Upgrades:[/b]

You can only buy mega upgrades once. They are quite expensive but provide a mega upgrade.

[list]
[*] [b]Beacon for Closed Exits[/b] (A beacon shows you which exits are locked)
[*] [b]Always Loot[/b] (Every grave contains loot)
[/list]
